description: Official Spanish Cadastre (Catastro) lookup: municipalities of a province with their Catastro codes, from the public OVCCallejero web service. Municipality level only; a property-level lookup needs a cadastral reference, which this tool does not take. Takes about 20 s; allow a 30 s timeout. Related tools on this server, for a different need: realestate_auction_com_property when you need HUD homes for sale by online bid in a US state or city; realestate_auction_com_property_scraper_ppe when you need upcoming U.S. Treasury auctions of seized/forfeited real. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

municipality.description: Municipality name, e.g. MADRID or BARCELONA

province.description: Province name in Spanish, uppercase, e.g. MADRID or BARCELONA
